title: Gospel Purpose Observation Grid
purpose: Support the primary activity for Why Four Gospels?.
body_markdown:
# Gospel Purpose Observation Grid

Use Luke 1:1-4; John 20:30-31 as your evidence.

1. Write or draw three direct observations.
2. Mark one interpretation or conclusion.
3. Name one careful response.
4. Put a question mark beside anything the passage does not settle by itself.
